mapper.sql: FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN health_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN health_checkin c ON c.user_id = u.id AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.checkin_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS studentTotal, COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS checkinStudents, COUNT(c.id) AS checkinRecords, AVG(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 THEN c.sleep_duration END) AS avgSleepDuration, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.stay_up_late = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stayUpLateCount, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.stay_up_late IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sleepFilledCount, AVG(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 THEN c.exercise_duration END) AS avgExerciseDuration, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.exercise_sufficient = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exerciseSufficientCount, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.exercise_sufficient IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exerciseFilledCount, AVG(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 THEN c.mood_score END) AS avgMoodScore, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.diet_breakfast = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS breakfastCount, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.diet_breakfast IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS breakfastFilledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormalRecords

SELECT c.checkin_date AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS checkinStudents, COUNT(c.id) AS checkinRecords, AVG(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 THEN c.sleep_duration END) AS avgSleepDuration, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.stay_up_late = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stayUpLateCount, AVG(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 THEN c.exercise_duration END) AS avgExerciseDuration, AVG(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 THEN c.mood_score END) AS avgMoodScore
AND c.id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.checkin_date ORDER BY c.checkin_date ASC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.college, ''), NULLIF(u.dept_name, ''), '未填写') AS college, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS studentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS checkinStudents, AVG(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 THEN c.sleep_duration END) AS avgSleepDuration, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.stay_up_late = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stayUpLateCount, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.stay_up_late IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sleepFilledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.exercise_sufficient = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exerciseSufficientCount, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.exercise_sufficient IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exerciseFilledCount
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.college, ''), NULLIF(u.dept_name, ''), '未填写') ORDER BY studentCount DESC, college ASC

SELECT c.emotion_type AS emotionType, CASE c.emotion_type WHEN 1 THEN '愉悦' WHEN 2 THEN '平静' WHEN 3 THEN '焦虑' WHEN 4 THEN '低落' WHEN 5 THEN '愤怒' ELSE '未知' END AS emotionName, COUNT(*) AS `count`
AND c.id IS NOT NULL AND c.data_quality = 0 AND c.emotion_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.emotion_type ORDER BY `count` DESC
mapper.sql: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.student_no AS studentNo, u.real_name AS realName, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.college, ''), NULLIF(u.dept_name, ''), '未填写') AS college, p.major AS major, p.grade AS grade, p.class_name AS className, COUNT(c.id) AS checkinDays, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS validDays, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormalDays, AVG(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 THEN c.sleep_duration END) AS avgSleepDuration, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.stay_up_late = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stayUpLateCount, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.stay_up_late IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sleepFilledCount, AVG(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 THEN c.exercise_duration END) AS avgExerciseDuration, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.exercise_sufficient = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exerciseInsufficientCount, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.exercise_sufficient = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exerciseSufficientCount, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.exercise_sufficient IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exerciseFilledCount, AVG(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 THEN c.mood_score END) AS avgMoodScore, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.diet_breakfast = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS breakfastCount, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.diet_breakfast IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS breakfastFilledCount, AVG(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 THEN c.water_intake END) AS avgWaterIntake, p.bmi AS bmi
GROUP BY u.id, u.student_no, u.real_name, p.college, u.dept_name, p.major, p.grade, p.class_name, p.bmi
mapper.select: HAVING ( SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.stay_up_late = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3 OR SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.exercise_sufficient = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5 OR SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3 ) ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.stay_up_late = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, SUM(CASE WHEN c.data_quality = 0 AND c.exercise_sufficient = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.college, ''), NULLIF(u.dept_name, '')) AS college FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN health_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE u.user_type = 1 AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.college, ''), NULLIF(u.dept_name, '')) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.college, ''), NULLIF(u.dept_name, '')) != '' ORDER BY college ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.grade FROM health_profile p JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.user_type = 1 AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.grade IS NOT NULL AND p.grade != '' ORDER BY p.grade ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.class_name FROM health_profile p JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.user_type = 1 AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.class_name IS NOT NULL AND p.class_name != '' ORDER BY p.class_name ASC
